[NERR.14.1] Every registered callback returns `ds_result_t` ([NCBK.1.1]). A
non-OK status propagates to the caller of whatever public function fired the
callback, but the metric and log callbacks', which the engine drops
([NCBK.1.5]). For a callback fired
during a pump that is `ds_engine_pump`, which runs to exhaustion and reports
the **first** callback error ([NERR.15.1]).
